findings: Quality bar violation: Scale Contrast - Multiple text elements use colors that appear to have insufficient contrast against the #0C0C0C background: .muted (#9A9A9A at 13px), footer (#8A8A8A at 13px), and .board-description (#9A9A9A at 13px). These gray values on near-black background may not meet the minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio requirement for normal text stated in the quality bars.

Quality bar violation: Spacing Rhythm - The CSS uses inconsistent spacing values without a clear spacing scale. At least 15 different values are hardcoded (4px, 6px, 8px, 10px, 12px, 14px, 16px, 18px, 20px, 22px, 28px, 32px, 64px) rather than using a consistent spacing scale as required by the quality bar 'Consistent spacing scale used throughout'.

Quality bar concern: Responsive Behavior - The .board-stages flexbox with 5 stage elements could cause horizontal scrolling on very narrow viewports (below ~400px width). While flex-wrap is used on .meta, the stages row has no wrapping or responsive media queries to handle mobile viewports gracefully. The quality bar requires 'No horizontal scrolling on standard viewports'.
